thermal.note: Sampled reasons alone do not establish clock stability, sustained state or matched A/B conditions

memory.accounting: RSS/PSS/anonymous/THP and cgroup charge overlap; never add them.

scope: Isolated components only. Empirical 32eps error envelope is not a global bound. Corrected selected scores and ordering are checked literally; flagged-only policies may leave unflagged ordering differences. All GPU detection, compaction, overflow/full rescore and selectors are included in paired stage times. Component scratch allocations are not runtime unique-memory claims. Variants are separately paired with F32, not directly interleaved with each other. No full-model quality, whole-model speed, default admission, counters or QPI claim.
